build_layoutlmv2_image_processor: build a LayoutLMv2ImageProcessorPil instance to preprocess document images with OCR enabled
run_tesseract_ocr_on_image: run Tesseract OCR on a document image to extract words and normalized bounding boxes
normalize_document_boxes: normalize bounding box coordinates to a 1000x1000 scale given image width and height
preprocess_document_images_with_ocr: preprocess a batch of document images with OCR to get pixel values, words, and bounding boxes
configure_ocr_language_and_config: configure OCR language and Tesseract config flags for the LayoutLMv2 image processor
